title: MP-MNCA: Morphology-Prior Masked Neighbor Cross-Attention for Efficient Spatial Domain Identification
abstract: arXiv:2610.16212v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Spatial transcriptomics jointly captures molecular state, tissue morphology, and spatial organization, yet spatial-domain methods are typically compared only at late training checkpoints, obscuring differences in convergence efficiency. We introduce MP-MNCA, a morphology-prior masked neighbor cross-attention framework that preserves the full 3,000 dimensional highly-variable-gene representation while selectively routing molecular information across spatial neighbors, with histological similarity incorporated as a continuous attention prior under a self-supervised masked neighbor-contrastive objective. Across 12 heterogeneous human dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC) sections, MP-MNCA is evaluated against established spatial-domain baselines using both convergence trajectories and epoch-wise spatial-domain visualizations. Our results show that MP-MNCA (i) reaches coherent spatial-domain structure in substantially fewer training epoch

translated_title: MP-MNCA：基于形态学先验的掩码邻居交叉注意力高效空间域识别方法
translated_abstract: 空间转录组学能够同时捕获分子状态、组织形态学与空间组织结构，然而现有空间域识别方法通常只在训练后期检查点进行比较，从而掩盖了收敛效率上的差异。我们提出MP-MNCA，这是一种形态学先验掩码邻居交叉注意力框架，它在保留完整的3,000维高变基因表示的同时，选择性地在空间邻居之间路由分子信息，并在自监督的掩码邻居对比学习目标下，将组织学相似性作为连续的注意力先验引入模型。在12个异质性的人类背外侧前额叶皮层（DLPFC）切片上，研究采用收敛轨迹和逐训练轮次的空间域可视化两种方式，将MP-MNCA与已有的空间域基线方法进行了评估比较。结果表明，MP-MNCA (i) 在明显更少的训练轮次内即可形成连贯的空间域结构（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出MP-MNCA框架，将组织形态学相似性作为连续注意力先验，通过掩码邻居交叉注意力与自监督对比学习，在保留完整3,000维基因表示的同时高效识别空间转录组学中的空间域结构，并显著提升收敛效率。
en_tdlr: MP-MNCA is a morphology-prior masked neighbor cross-attention framework that preserves full 3,000-dimensional gene representations and leverages histological similarity as a continuous attention prior under self-supervised contrastive learning, enabling efficient spatial domain identification with substantially improved convergence.
